_comment: Per-ticker override file. Copy to overrides/TICKER.json and edit. All fields are optional.
_wacc_note: WACC inputs — set wacc_override to skip CAPM computation entirely.
_tax_note: Tax rate (statutory / normalised). Overrides CATR computation.
_flags_note: Feature flags — set to true to enable specialist modules.
_bridge_note: EV→equity bridge adjustments. All values USD millions.
_comps_note: Fields below are used by the comps module, not ValuationConfig.
_proforma_note: Optional pro forma adjustments per peer (Part 78.2).
_transactions_note: Precedent transactions (Part 77.3). All values in USD millions.
_debt_note: Override debt schedule if FMP data is stale or incorrect.
_share_note: Override diluted share count if FMP is materially wrong.
_pension_note: Override pension underfunding if not available via FMP.
_lease_note: Finance lease obligations if FMP does not include them in total_debt.
_currency_note: If reporting in non-USD, provide FX rate override.
